caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model (type = small) across six epochs, comparing four different weight quantization strategies: small AdaLoRA_int4 (solid orange line with circle markers), small AdaLoRA_int8 (dashed orange line with square markers), small int4 (solid yellow-orange line with circle markers), and small int8 (dashed yellow-orange line with square markers). The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The small AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at WER ≈ 30.0, peaks at epoch 2 (≈33.8), then declines to ≈30.5 at epoch 6. The small AdaLoRA_int8 line begins at ≈35.5, rises sharply to a peak of ≈42.2 at epoch 2, then steadily decreases to ≈31.5 by epoch 6. The small int4 line starts at ≈30.0, drops to ≈28.5 by epoch 2, then continues falling to ≈25.2 at epoch 6. The small int8 line begins at ≈30.0, dips slightly to ≈29.8 at epoch 1, rises to ≈33.5 at epoch 2, then declines to ≈25.5 by epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend after epoch 2, indicating improved performance with continued training, though the AdaLoRA_int8 variant exhibits the highest initial error and the most pronounced peak.
